_readme: Edit the values below, then run `node build.mjs` and upload the contents of dist/ to public_html/. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Empty required fields show as yellow placeholders on the site and are listed when you build.
_legalName: REQUIRED. Your registered business name, or your own full name if you run it as a sole proprietor. Must match your Razorpay KYC.
_supportEmail: REQUIRED. Use an inbox you actually read (a Gmail is fine). An @rankveer.com address will NOT receive mail until the domain's DNS is sorted.
_supportPhone: Optional. Shown on the Contact page if filled, e.g. +91 98765 43210
_businessAddress: REQUIRED. Payment gateways check that the website lists one.
_grievanceOfficerName: REQUIRED. Name of the person handling complaints, as required under India's IT Rules. Can be you.
_jurisdictionCity: REQUIRED. City whose courts govern the Terms, usually where you are based, e.g. Lucknow
_playStoreUrl: The app on Google Play (live since 29 Oct 2026). Every download button points here.
_apkUrl: Direct download while the app is not on Google Play yet. Use ONLY the 'Signed, universal APK' from Play Console (App bundle explorer > Downloads) so people can later update from Google Play without reinstalling. Upload it to public_html/download/. Clear apkUrl once playStoreUrl is set. Play Console > Protected with Play > Automatic protection must stay OFF while this is offered, or the APK shows 'Get this app from Play' on every launch.
_apkNote: Since the app is on Google Play the APK is only a small fallback link under the Play button. Keep it in step with the Play release or clear apkUrl.
_stats: Numbers shown on the homepage. Count them again before changing - never round up past the real figure. statsAsOf is printed under them.
_pyqAvailable: Previous year papers actually in the app, named on the homepage so nobody expects more than exists.
